## Walkthrough

The pull request centralizes command-line argument definitions by introducing an exported ARGS constant mapping semantic option names to string literals (name, config, pvm, fast-forward, init-genesis-from-ancestry, version). Additionally, comprehensive tests are added to args.test.ts covering fuzz-target command parsing scenarios with various flag formats and the init-genesis-from-ancestry option in different positions.
